question: In April 2025, which Indian cricketer was named for Wisden Leading Cricketers in the World 2024 who scored 1659 runs across formats in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Smriti Mandhana was named Wisden Leading Cricketer in the World 2024 for her exceptional performance across formats.
 
• In the year 2024, she scored a remarkable 1659 runs in international cricket across formats.
 
• Her performance included centuries and match-winning innings in both ODIs and T20Is, showcasing her consistency and adaptability.
 
• She became the second Indian woman, after Mithali Raj, to earn this prestigious recognition by Wisden.
 
• The award celebrates her contribution to Indian cricket and her impact on the global stage as one of the finest batters in women's cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wisden Cricketer of the Year:** An annual award given by the Wisden Cricketers' Almanack to recognize outstanding cricketing performances globally.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana's Career Highlights:** She is known for her elegant left-handed batting style and has been a key player for India in international cricket since her debut in 2013.
 
• **Women’s Cricket Growth:** In recent years, women’s cricket has gained significant popularity, with players like Mandhana playing a pivotal role in its development.
 
• **Achievements in 2024:** Apart from her runs, Mandhana contributed significantly to India's victories in major series and tournaments in 2024.
 
• **Wisden Leading Cricketer:** This title is separate from the Wisden Five Cricketers of the Year and focuses on the best player globally for a specific year.
